• A2DP (music profile) is stereo output only; its microphone needs the hands-free profile (HFP), which Windows exposes as a separate mono 'Hands-Free' endpoint and drops the output to phone quality while it is open.

• Blocks under 256 frames gain nothing here; 512 is a good start.

TRUE BUFFER: smallest stable block for this driver

FAST runs the driver's block as it comes (no extra buffering), limits the master at -1.0 dBTP with a 4x true-peak detector, skips inserts that are off, flat EQ and silent channels, shares the channels over several processor cores and refreshes the meters less often. The block shown is only a suggestion: pick it under BLOCK. Leaving FAST restores the limiter.

Play your sources as in the show, then LISTEN: every channel is measured for 4 seconds (level, voice band 300-3400 Hz, brightness, zero crossings, pauses, crest, stereo) and sorted by fixed rules into VOICE, MUSIC or INSTRUMENT. While a voice (the KEY) is above the threshold, the music (the TARGET) goes down by the depth and comes back after the hold and release. Smooth, sample by sample in the engine.

AUTO FADER rides each channel's fader toward its target loudness (short-term, 3 s) within a range around your own position, at a limited speed. AUTO ON/OFF fades a silent channel out after the hold and brings it back at once. Moving a fader pauses its ride for 5 s and makes the new position the centre. Order: fader + DCA, then the ride, auto on/off, automix and the ducker.
